responsibility: This file implements the backend type system support used by gfortran lowering. It initializes target-dependent Fortran kind tables and canonical tree nodes for integer, real, complex, logical, character, pointer, and char-length types; constructs array descriptors, CFI descriptors, dtype records, CAF reference/vector types, and derived-type layouts; and provides the routines that map resolved Fortran symbols and type specs to backend tree types and function types, supplying the type metadata consumed throughout declaration, expression, array, and runtime-call translation.
same_name_distinction: Implements backend type construction and initialization: kind tables, canonical type nodes, array/CFI descriptor layouts, dtype and CAF reference types, and mapping from Fortran symbols/specs to tree types. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans-types.h, it performs the type-building work instead of merely exposing the type API and globals.
